title: Does Fast Charging Really Hurt Your EV Battery? #shorts

scenes.text: Does fast charging really hurt your electric car's battery? Here's what the data says.
One study tracked more than 22,000 electric cars.
Cars that mostly charged slowly lost about one and a half percent of their battery per year.
Cars that relied heavily on high-power fast chargers lost about three percent. That's double.
After eight years, that's roughly 88 percent of the battery left, against 76.
So fast charging is fine for road trips. Just don't make it your daily habit.
